welcome.title: Welcome to Lemru
welcome.description: One API for many AI models, with your data where you allow it.

access.title: One API key
access.description: Reach every model in the catalog with one key, in the OpenAI request format.

policy.title: Your data policy
policy.description: Choose the regions, the retention and whether providers may train on your requests.

prepaid.title: Prepaid in riyals
prepaid.description: No subscription. Add credit and pay only for the tokens you use.

welcome.question: How will you be using Lemru?
welcome.changeLater: You can change this later: you keep a personal account and can create or join organizations at any time.

individual.title: Individual
individual.description: Build side projects, explore models and prototype ideas.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Work with your team and manage keys, credit and usage in one place.

welcome.locked: Your starter key has been created in this account. You can create or join organizations from the dashboard at any time.

organization.title: Set up your organization
organization.description: It gets its own credit, API keys and data policy, separate from your personal account.

name.label: Organization name
name.created: The organization is created. You can rename it later in its settings.

invite.label: Invite team members
invite.description: Optional. Each person gets an email with a link to join.
invite.invalid: One of the email addresses is not valid.
invite.failed: These invitations could not be sent: {{emails}}. Send them again from Members.

ready.title: Your account is ready
ready.description: Your API keys, usage and credit are in one place. Here is a first key so you can start making requests.

key.label: Your API key
key.once: This is the only time the full key is shown. You can create a new one at any time.
key.limit: It can spend up to {{amount}}, in case it leaks.
key.unavailable: A starter key could not be created right now. You can create one on the API keys page.

request.label: Make your first request
request.note: Requests are paid from your prepaid credit: add credit on the Credits page before the first one.
